use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

    let source = r#"$color: red;
body { color: $color; }"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"scss"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
